notes.title: Now the game should run stably on Linux. And the latest development news
notes.notes:
At the numerous requests, we have fixed the game launch from the Steam client on the Linux operating system. Now the Steam client should properly recognize our game.

I hope those who have started playing the game now won't encounter any issues with their saves due to the update. During testing on my old saves, there were no problems. I hope the same goes for you.

We are also finishing up the second episode of The Devilry Reservation. I think its completion will be a challenging task due to the large amount of translation work and the expanding volume of the game. We could release the game earlier with just the English version, but I think it wouldn't be fair to other people who don't know this language.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539300/The_Devilry_Reservation___II/

We have also started developing our new project "Emptiness." Its demo version is already available on the Steam game page. You can play the demo and leave your feedback in the Google form at the end. With your feedback, we can make our new product better than we imagine it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761760/Emptiness/

Thank you for staying with us. 
Team GentFish

notes.title: Happy New Year! And small plans and news.
notes.notes:
Congratulations to everyone on the New Year! This year, we released our first game and have plans for a new one. For those awaiting the second chapter of The Devilry Reservation, it is expected to be released in 2024, aiming for March, although this plan may seem ambitious considering the second episode is three times larger than the first. We look forward to new and exciting detective investigations, discovering new bugs, and continuing the story everyone deserves! Happy New Year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43649177/daddb3bc8eedf43e277836c02f99f1fae8806897.png[/img]

Let me also tell you about our new project - a game called "Emptiness." It will be a very interesting and challenging endeavor for us and an intriguing game for you. Perhaps its Steam page will be available soon. Add the Second Episode and our new game to your wishlists! And yes, we continue to create games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43649177/663a834ae74aac451e2b4dba802c29cc0c3aa8a5.png[/img]

notes.title: Update from 10/12/2023
notes.notes:
We have great respect for the Scandinavian culture and decided to add languages for Scandinavian players. Often players from these countries are deprived of translations into their native languages. We (as best we can) strive to restore justice and provide all players with comfortable access to our gaming literary history.

-Added Norwegian localization.
-Added Swedish localization.
-Added Danish localization.
-Added Finnish localization.

If there are any problems with the translation, please report them to us.

notes.title: Update from 10/04/2023
notes.notes:
-Fixed a critical bug with the electrical panel, which caused the game to freeze without the ability to continue. There was a bug where interacting with an ax would break the electrical panel quest. The ax deleted the interaction sprite.

-Fixed a bug in interaction with characters and the box. There was a bug where the player could not start a conversation when simultaneously kicking a box and trying to talk to a character. This oversight could only be corrected by interacting with the door.

-Fixed a typo in a word in one of the dialogues.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539300/The_Devilry_Reservation___II/

notes.title: Update from 09/27/2023
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where the game would freeze completely after scanning the Obertun character. We were informed that the game was freezing due to scanning. This was due to the fact that we did not foresee certain factors during the development of the second chapter of the game.

-Fixed a bug due to which the dialogue about "irresponsibility" did not appear when all the conditions that trigger it were met. It turns out that not a single player who completed our game to the end saw this very dialogue. He just didn't show up. Now he is. It seems like a small thing, but it’s nice.

-Fixed a bug where the player heard the sound of footsteps when chopping wood. Many may not have noticed this, but that’s how it was.

-Fixed the display of the “Night” aura. This character's aura was flipped to the right side.

-Fixed a bug where when scanning Shishiga she would break the text window.

notes.title: We wait? It's true?
notes.notes:
We are still working on the second chapter of the game. I hope that closer to release you will all add the game to your "Wishlist".

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539300/The_Devilry_Reservation___II/

We recently had a funny situation where it seemed like the game's development would stop for an indefinite period of time (Perhaps even a year or two). All because of the blocking of Binance in our country, or rather p2p transfers. Using this service, we paid for a subscription to the game engine that we use to create the game. But with difficulty, having spent 7 hours completing this operation, we were able to extend the development for another 2 months by paying for a subscription. We hope that we will be able to finish the second chapter during this time. Although they constantly put a spoke in our wheels, they constantly introduce new restrictions - but we don’t stop making the game, and we just want to make good games.

We are far from global ambitions that bring in millions of dollars, but we want to remain in the hearts of each of you. We'll be in touch, see you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43649177/796bd94259dbec390b83ac38b8227483a0973428.jpg[/img]

Here's a small screenshot from the second chapter of the game. I think this is seriously intriguing.

notes.title: Update from 09/18/2023
notes.notes:
-Fixed display of Japanese game text. There was a problem with displaying Japanese text, when it did not fit and was cut off in the text information output field. This issue occurs because Japanese letters are wider than others and the text field has a character limit.

-Fixed a bug where the player managed to enter the door faster than a ghost in one of the apartments. Because of this error, the player ended up in an apartment and could not get out of it.

-Added text with important information displayed in the game settings menu, namely it relates to text language settings.

[b]Don't forget about us. We are currently making the second chapter of the game. I hope we will have time to finish it before the end of autumn. [/b]

notes.title: Major update from 09/08/2023
notes.notes:
-Added the ability to interact with objects in a larger radius and from the back. Previously, it was necessary to look heroes in the face. Now this is not necessary. The hero himself will approach the desired point for conversation.

-Added “Esc” indicator when scanning an entity with the pen. Many players did not even realize that information about scanned creatures can be read. We hope that the indicator will fix this.
-Added a circle for interacting with a PC in one of the apartments in the first chapter of the game. Many players did not understand how to turn off the music.

-Added a sagging light bulb on the second floor. Many people missed out on additional activities in the game because they didn't know that light bulbs could be broken. To activate the activity, you need to break at least 2 light bulbs in the entrance.

-Fixed a bug due to which music stopped playing after saving.


[b]Thanks to everyone who bought the game. We kindly ask you to add the second chapter of the game to your wishlist. Have a nice day![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539300/The_Devilry_Reservation___II/
